notes: Event date: 17 April 1945 (Last Offensive ch. 17 p. 399: the combat commander of Magdeburg refused an ultimatum to surrender; after a strike by 350 medium bombers of the 9th Bombardment Division during the afternoon of 17 April, the 30th Division and parts of the 2d Armored Division began a systematic reduction of the city). Event definition: the division opens the attack on the city; the row is the objective, not the command post.
